† בָּֽשְׂמַת n.pr.f. (perfume?)—
1. Hittite woman, a wife of Esau Gn 26:34 (P); called daughter of Ishmael, and sister of Nebaioth Gn 36:3 (but due prob. to R; this daughter of Ishmael is מַחֲלַת in 28:9 P); v. also 36:4, 10, 13, 17 (all P) (Sam. has מחלת throughout Gn 36).
2. daughter of Solomon, wife of Ahimaaz 1 K 4:15.
